section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Nutrition & Food Components — Deep 3
subject: Science
stem: Foods like ghee, butter, and cooking oil are concentrated sources of which nutrient, which provides more than double the energy per gram compared to carbohydrates?
explanation: Fats provide about 9 kcal per gram (more than double carbohydrates' ~4 kcal/gram), serving as a concentrated energy source and aiding absorption of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).

section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Nutrition & Food Components — Deep 3
subject: Science
stem: Although it provides no calories, this substance makes up roughly 60-70% of the human body, is essential for nearly every bodily process, and its deficiency causes dehydration. It is:
explanation: Water is not a nutrient in the caloric sense but is essential for virtually all body functions (digestion, temperature regulation, transport) — it is often classified alongside the six essential nutrient groups for this reason.
